metaTitle: Tejas Patel Tennis Center: Tennis in Tampa
metaDescription: Hillsborough College lists the Tejas Pradip Patel Tennis Center at 813.348.1173. Weekdays run 8 a.m. to 9 p.m., and weekend days end at 2 p.m.

publish.hoursNote: The college page says its tennis website is under construction. Our listing street, 3901 W Tampa Bay Blvd, is not printed on that page.

facts: The Tejas Pradip Patel HCC Tennis Center, Hillsborough College. The college page says to call 813.348.1173 for court reservations, programming, membership, class registration, and other tennis inquiries. Email hcctenniscenter@gmail.com. That phone matches our listing (813) 348-1173. The college switchboard on the same page is 813.253.7000. The page says the new website is currently under construction. Website https://www.hcfl.edu/tennis-center.
Day hours: Monday 8 a.m. – 9 p.m. Tuesday 8 a.m. – 9 p.m. Wednesday 8 a.m. – 9 p.m. Thursday 8 a.m. – 9 p.m. Friday 8 a.m. – 9 p.m. Saturday 8 a.m. – 2 p.m. Sunday 8 a.m. – 2 p.m.
Our listing address is 3901 W Tampa Bay Blvd, Tampa, FL 33614. That street line is not printed on the college page we saved.

Nearby from our coordinates: EchoPark Automotive 0.6 miles at 4636 N Dale Mabry Hwy, slug echopark-automotive-tampa. Exxon 0.85 miles at 4800 N Dale Mabry Hwy, slug exxon-2. Cooper's Hawk 0.86 miles at 4110 W Boy Scout Blvd, slug coopers-hawk.

faq.q: What hours does the college page list?
faq.a: Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. Saturday and Sunday, 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.

faq.q: Which phone is for the tennis center?
faq.a: 813.348.1173, and the email is hcctenniscenter@gmail.com. 813.253.7000 is the college switchboard on the same footer.

faq.q: Does the college page print the street?
faq.a: The page we saved names the center and the phone. It does not print 3901 W Tampa Bay Blvd. That street is our listing address.
